description: This file is a Perl module implementing 'Git::SVN', which provides integration between Git and Subversion repositories. It includes functions for repository initialization, remote configuration, revision mapping, property walking, and commit management for a git-svn bridge. The module handles low-level interactions with SVN, manages revision-to-commit mappings, and supports complex operations like alterations of repository roots and UUIDs, as well as handling mergeinfo and merge operations.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: This class provides the core functionality for interacting with SVN repositories from Git, including configuration, revision mapping, property traversal, synchronization, and commit operations.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves local glob references to specific SVN refs based on the provided refspec.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments, handling special cases like 'BASE:HEAD', numeric revisions, and 'HEAD'.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all relevant revisions and data from a remote SVN repository based on the configuration and remotes.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads and parses the SVN remote configurations from Git config.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes internal variables related to garbage collection and repository configuration.

methods.name: verify_remotes_sanity
methods.description: Verifies the correctness and sanity of SVN remote configurations.

methods.name: find_existing_remote
methods.description: Finds an existing remote matching the given URL to avoid duplication.

methods.name: init_remote_config
methods.description: Initializes SVN remote configuration within Git, setting URLs, fetch paths, and properties.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Finds a Git::SVN instance corresponding to a given SVN URL and optional repo root and path.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN object, initializing configuration such as URL, path, remote id, and ref id.

methods.name: refname
methods.description: Returns a sanitized SVN reference name suitable for use in refs.

methods.name: desanitize_refname
methods.description: Reverts the sanitization of an SVN refname back to its original form.

methods.name: svm_uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the Subversion mirror (SVM) if available.

methods.name: svm
methods.description: Returns SVM-related configuration properties.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Memoizes and retrieves the repository UUID, either from config or remotely.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Retrieves the repository root URL, configured or from remote info.

methods.name: ra
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an SVN::Ra object representing the remote repository.

methods.name: prop_walk
methods.description: Recursively walks SVN properties at a specified revision, invoking a callback for directories with properties.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the latest SVN revision number for the current ref.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest SVN commit SHA1 for the current ref.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Calculates and caches the latest revision and commit info.

methods.name: get_fetch_range
methods.description: Returns the range of revisions to fetch based on the specified minimum and maximum.

methods.name: svn_dir
methods.description: Gets the SVN directory path in the Git namespace.

methods.name: tmp_config
methods.description: Manages temporary SVN config environment for SVN operations.

methods.name: tmp_index_do
methods.description: Runs operations with a temporary Git index file environment.

methods.name: assert_index_clean
methods.description: Ensures the index tree matches the expected state before operations.

methods.name: get_commit_parents
methods.description: Determines parent commits for a given SVN log entry.

methods.name: rewrite_root
methods.description: Returns the rewrite root URL if configured, used for URL rewriting.

methods.name: rewrite_uuid
methods.description: Returns the rewrite UUID if configured, used for UUID rewriting.

methods.name: metadata_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL used for associated metadata or mirror info.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Constructs the full SVN URL from the base URL and local path.

methods.name: full_pushurl
methods.description: Constructs the full push URL, considering push URL overrides.

methods.name: set_commit_header_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables related to commit author and date info.

methods.name: restore_commit_header_env
methods.description: Restores environment variables after a commit.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on the Git repository.

methods.name: do_git_commit
methods.description: Creates a git commit from an SVN log entry, managing commit environments and annotations.

methods.name: match_paths
methods.description: Determines if a given path matches certain criteria, used for filtering.

methods.name: find_parent_branch
methods.description: Attempts to find a parent branch point in SVN for the current ref.

methods.name: do_fetch
methods.description: Performs fetching of revisions from SVN, integrating new log entries and revision data.

methods.name: mkemptydirs
methods.description: Creates empty directories in the working tree based on logs of directory deletions.

methods.name: get_untracked
methods.description: Retrieves a list of untracked or unmanaged files/directories for commit.

methods.name: parse_svn_date
methods.description: Parses SVN date strings into a Git-compatible format, optionally converting to local timezone.

methods.name: other_gs
methods.description: Finds or initializes a Git::SVN object for a given URL, possibly creating a new one.

methods.name: call_authors_prog
methods.description: Runs an external program to resolve author information.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Verifies and normalizes author info, invoking an external program if configured.

methods.name: find_extra_svk_parents
methods.description: Analyzes SVK merge properties to find extra parent commits.

methods.name: lookup_svn_merge
methods.description: Looks up SVN merge info, including rev ranges and merge tips.

methods.name: _rev_list
methods.description: Returns a list of revisions based on 'rev-list' command output.

methods.name: check_cherry_pick2
methods.description: Checks if commits can be cherry-picked, identifying missing changes.

methods.name: has_no_changes
methods.description: Determines whether a commit introduces any changes.

methods.name: tie_for_persistent_memoization
methods.description: Sets up persistent memoization caches for SVN merge info functions.

methods.name: unmemoize_svn_mergeinfo_functions
methods.description: Removes memoization hooks to clear caches.

methods.name: clear_memoized_mergeinfo_caches
methods.description: Clears persistent caches for merge info functions.

methods.name: parents_exclude
methods.description: Computes excluded parent commits based on rev-list strategies.

methods.name: mergeinfo_changes
methods.description: Calculates differences in svn:mergeinfo between revisions.

methods.name: find_extra_svn_parents
methods.description: Determines additional SVN parent revisions based on mergeinfo.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Constructs a log entry from SVN revision data, including metadata and merge info.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches SVN revisions and integrates them into the local Git repository.

methods.name: set_tree_cb
methods.description: Callback to set the tree state during a Git commit.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Sets the repository tree for Git commit based on SVN revision.

methods.name: rebuild_from_rev_db
methods.description: Rebuilds revision-to-commit mappings from stored revision database.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the revision mapping cache for the repository.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Maps SVN revision numbers to Git commits, optionally updating refs and UUIDs.
